column3: [NFR][TS-02][TC-01] Verify that the system can process the equivalent of one production business day of TDN trades while maintaining acceptable performance and resource utilization
column5:
Test Suite: TS-02
Test Case: TC-01
Category: Performance

Objective
Verify that the system can process the equivalent of one production business day of TDN trades while maintaining acceptable performance and resource utilization

Steps / Expected Results
1. Action: Inject a workload equivalent to one production day for TDN accounts
   Expected: All events are processed successfully
2. Action: Measure transactions per second (TPS)
   Expected: TPS meets or exceeds the target throughput
3. Action: Monitor JVM memory consumption
   Expected: Memory usage remains stable with no excessive garbage collection activity
4. Action: Monitor Kafka topic growth and retention
   Expected: Topic size remains within expected limits
5. Action: Analyze database storage consumption (tables and indexes)
   Expected: Database growth remains within expected capacity limits

column3: [NFR][TS-04][TC-02] Verify that Zephyr can recover from a Kafka outage and correctly process buffered events once Kafka becomes available again
column5:
Test Suite: TS-04
Test Case: TC-02
Category: Resiliency

Objective
Verify that Zephyr can recover from a Kafka outage and correctly process buffered events once Kafka becomes available again

Steps / Expected Results
1. Action: Start Zephyr while Kafka is unavailable
   Expected: Zephyr starts successfully and stores incoming events in the database
2. Action: Inject trade events into the system
   Expected: All trade-related events are persisted without loss
3. Action: Start the Kafka broker
   Expected: All pending events are published to Kafka and processing resumes normally

Test Suite: TS-05
Test Case: TC-01
Category: Recovery

Objective
Verify recovery after database failure

Steps / Expected Results
1. Action: Start Zephyr with Database failover mode enabled
   Expected: Zephyr starts successfully and connects to the primary database
2. Action: Stop the primary database instance
   Expected: Zephyr detects the database failure and stops
3. Action: Restart Zephyr
   Expected: Zephyr automatically connects to the secondary database and resumes processing

Test Suite: TS-05
Test Case: TC-02
Category: Recovery

Objective
Verify recovery after application crash

Steps / Expected Results
1. Action: Start one Zephyr instance configured for 4 firms (GSS, CFL, KOP and SGP)
   Expected: The instance starts successfully and all firms are loaded
2. Action: Kill the Zephyr process during processing
   Expected: Processing stops immediately and any uncommitted transactions are rolled back safely
3. Action: Restart Zephyr
   Expected: Zephyr restarts and resumes without data loss

column3: [NFR][TS-05][TC-03] Verify that Zephyr can recover successfully when the outage duration exceeds the database UNDO retention period and Flashback query is no longer available
column5:
Test Suite: TS-05
Test Case: TC-03
Category: Recovery

Objective
Verify that Zephyr can recover successfully when the outage duration exceeds the database UNDO retention period and Flashback query is no longer available

Steps / Expected Results
1. Action: Start one Zephyr instance configured for 4 firms (GSS, CFL, KOP and SGP)
   Expected: The instance starts successfully and all firms are loaded
2. Action: Kill the Zephyr process and keep it offline for longer than the database UNDO retention period
   Expected: No processing occurs while the application is offline
3. Action: Restart Zephyr
   Expected: Zephyr starts successfully, detects that Flashback query mode is unavailable, automatically switches to DELTA recovery mode, and resumes processing without data loss
